svg.title: Raingentic commerce system architecture
svg.desc: Complete seller setup, buyer negotiation, A2A, AP2, Monad x402, Rain controlled cards, Solidity escrow, evidence provenance, delivery verification, and treasury experiments.

text.tspan: From existing business systems to negotiated, authorized, settled, and verified agent transactions
Turn existing products and APIs into a governed, agent-readable storefront
The model can propose and negotiate; deterministic code and people control authority
AP2 selects an approved rail. Payment and delivery evidence remain bound to the mandate
18 PreFlight API operations · data products · software
Approve or stop; no money moves
Open-web research can use Tavily; it is not required for the controlled demo.
The chain is in the actual machine-purchase path, not an unrelated contract.
Buyer/seller wallets · test USDC · x402 client/server · settlement verification
Reach traditional merchants with bounded card authority
Fiat ↔ RUSD simulations stay labeled sandbox, not bank transfers
Not required for x402 or ordinary Rain card purchases.
Inputs and responses retain explicit provenance instead of pretending every field is live
FAA: airspace · TFR/FDC NOTAM · airports · obstacles
Every operation can be priced independently
Full FAA NOTAM needs authorized access
Visible product direction, separated from the core transaction proof
No providers connected; no funds move
No eligibility decision or investment advice
Solid lines = working transaction flow · Dashed lines = optional, controlled, or non-core path
Monad Testnet · Rain sandbox · controlled demo fixtures
